scope: Three full performance-harness repetitions on explicit C SSD paths. Original gates unchanged. Real query embeddings, synthetic 10000-fact vectors and capture provider; no cognition calls or semantic-quality claims. Shared workstation, not an idle-lab speedup attribution.

retrieval.actual_store_stage_timing_note: Per-call store timings are nested within full retrieval latency. The mark_and_refresh field sums the traced metadata update and refresh reads within that retrieval; do not sum it with other store stages.

instrumentation.note: Each measured query executes one engine.retrieve call. Component timings and candidate counts come from its traced store calls; the v1 post-retrieval mark/get probe is not comparable.

retrieval.load_fixture: synthetic vectors derived from one observed Ollama embedding; semantic quality NOT RUN
